children.name: Petrosavia sakuraii  J.J.Sm. ex Steenis
children.description: thumbPetrosavia sakuraii, one of three species in the genus Petrosavia, is a monocotyledonous plant first described by Tomitaro Makino in 1903 (see illustration), distributed in eastern and south-eastern Asia.

children.name: Japonolirion osense Nakai
children.description: Japonolirion is a genus of plants in the family Petrosaviaceae. There is only one known species, Japonolirion osense, endemic to Japan.
